info.title: Procest Case Management Register
info.description: Register containing all schemas for the Procest case management application. Defines case types, status types, role types, result types, decision types, document types, property definitions, voorstel, parafeerroute, parafeeractie, automaticAction, and their instance counterparts.

caseType.title: Case Type
caseType.description: Case type definition — defines the blueprint for a category of cases including lifecycle, deadlines, and classification

description.description: Detailed description of this case type

purpose.description: The purpose or goal of this case type

trigger.description: What triggers the creation of a case of this type

subject.description: The subject matter of this case type

processingDeadline.description: ISO 8601 duration for the processing deadline (e.g. P30D)

isDraft.description: Whether this case type is a draft (not yet published)

validFrom.description: Date from which this case type is valid

validUntil.description: Date until which this case type is valid (null = indefinite)

suspensionAllowed.description: Whether cases of this type can be suspended

extensionAllowed.description: Whether the processing deadline can be extended

extensionPeriod.description: ISO 8601 duration for extension period (e.g. P14D)

publicationRequired.description: Whether publication of the decision is required

internalOrExternal.description: Whether the case type is internal or external

productsOrServices.description: URLs to products or services (JSON-encoded array)

selectionListProcessType.description: URL to the selection list process type

decisionTypes.description: References to decision types (besluittypen) linked to this case type

defaultAssignee.description: Nextcloud user UID or group ID for automatic assignment of cases of this type (REQ-INTAKE-03a)
defaultAssignee.title: Default assignee

workflowDefinition.description: UUID reference to the pinned active workflowTemplate for this case type. When unset, new cases fall through to the latest published workflowTemplate for this caseType. New cases are bound to the version that is published+isActive at the moment of case creation (see case.workflowTemplate + case.workflowVersion).

layerIds.description: Subscribed wmsLayer UUIDs visible on this case type's maps (wms-wfs-layers REQ-WMS-4). Empty array = only isDefault layers visible.

statusType.title: Status Type
statusType.description: Status lifecycle phase definition for a case type

name.description: Name of this status (e.g. Ontvangen, In behandeling)

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

order.description: Position in the status lifecycle (lower = earlier)

isFinal.description: Whether this is a terminal/final status

resultType.title: Result Type
resultType.description: Case outcome type with archival rules

name.description: Name of this result type (e.g. Vergunning verleend)

genericDescription.description: Generic description derived from selectielijst resultaattypeomschrijving

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

archivalAction.description: What to do after archival period: keep or destroy

sourceDateArchiveProcedure.description: BrondatumArchiefprocedure configuration (JSON-encoded object with afleidingswijze, procestermijn, datumkenmerk, etc.)

roleType.title: Role Type
roleType.description: Participant role type definition for a case type

name.description: Name of this role type (e.g. Behandelaar, Adviseur)

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

propertyDefinition.title: Property Definition
propertyDefinition.description: Custom field definition for a case type

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

isRequired.description: Whether this property is required on cases

documentType.title: Document Type
documentType.description: Document type requirement for a case type

name.description: Name of this document type (e.g. Situatietekening)

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

isDraft.description: Whether this document type is a draft (concept)

isRequired.description: Whether this document is required for the case

validFrom.description: Date from which this document type is valid

validUntil.description: Date until which this document type is valid

decisionType.title: Decision Type
decisionType.description: Decision type definition for a case type

caseType.description: Reference to the parent case type

isDraft.description: Whether this decision type is a draft (concept)

publicationRequired.description: Whether this decision type requires publication

caseTypes.description: References to case types (array of zaaktype URLs)

documentTypes.description: References to document types (array of informatieobjecttype URLs)

validFrom.description: Date from which this decision type is valid

validUntil.description: Date until which this decision type is valid

case.title: Case
case.description: A case instance in the case management system

status.description: Reference to the current status type
status.title: Status

result.description: Reference to the result record (set on completion)

assignee.description: Nextcloud user ID of the primary handler
assignee.title: Assignee

intakeChannel.description: The channel through which this case was intaken (REQ-INTAKE-08b, REQ-INTAKE-11a)
intakeChannel.title: Intake channel

geometry.description: GeoJSON geometry for location-based cases (JSON-encoded object)

sourceOrganisation.description: RSIN of the organization that created this case

archiveNomination.description: Whether the case should be permanently archived or destroyed

archiveActionDate.description: Date when the archive action should be executed

archiveStatus.description: Current archive status of the case

communicationChannel.description: URL reference to the communication channel

workflowTemplate.description: Reference to the bound workflow template

workflowVersion.description: Version number of the bound workflow template

assignee.description: Nextcloud user ID of the assigned user
assignee.title: Assignee

workflowStepId.description: UUID of the workflow step that generated this task

checklist.description: JSON-encoded array of checklist items ({id, label, checked})

role.title: Role
role.description: A role assignment on a case

name.description: Display name for this role assignment

participant.description: Nextcloud user ID or contact reference

delegate.description: Optional participant (Nextcloud user ID or contact ref) acting on behalf of the original participant during the delegation window

delegateUntil.description: End of the delegation window (ISO 8601). MUST be greater than or equal to delegateFrom

statusRecord.title: Status Record
statusRecord.description: A status transition record for a case

dispatchedActions.description: Snapshot of automatic actions dispatched for this transition

noWorkflowTemplate.description: True when the transition was admin free-form on a caseType without an active workflowTemplate

decision.title: Decision

governingBody.description: The governing body that made the decision (bestuursorgaan)

document.description: A document (enkelvoudig informatieobject) in the document registry

content.description: Base64-encoded file content or file reference

usageRightsIndication.description: Indicates whether usage rights have been set for this document

documentLink.title: Document Link
documentLink.description: A link between a document and a case or decision

object.description: URI reference to the related object (zaak or besluit)

kanaal.description: A notification channel (kanaal) for ZGW event distribution

naam.description: Name of this channel (e.g. zaken, documenten)

documentatieLink.description: URL to API documentation for this channel

filters.description: Available filter attributes for this channel (JSON-encoded array)

abonnement.title: Notification Subscription
abonnement.description: A subscription (abonnement) for receiving ZGW notifications

auth.description: Authorization header value for callback requests

kanalen.description: Channels and filters to subscribe to (JSON-encoded array)

catalogus.title: Catalogus
catalogus.description: A catalogus groups case types, decision types, and document types

contactpersoonBeheerTelefoonnummer.description: Phone number of the management contact

zaaktypeInformatieobjecttype.description: Links a case type to a document type with direction and ordering

richting.description: Direction of the document in the case

caseProperty.title: Case Property
caseProperty.description: A property value on a specific case

caseDocument.title: Case Document Link
caseDocument.description: Links a document to a case

caseObject.title: Case Object
caseObject.description: Links an external object to a case

customerContact.title: Customer Contact
customerContact.description: A customer contact moment for a case

decisionDocument.title: Decision Document Link
decisionDocument.description: Links a document to a decision

startDate.description: Start date of the usage rights

endDate.description: End date of the usage rights

voorstel.title: Voorstel
voorstel.description: A B&W voorstel (proposal) for decision-making in a case

onderwerp.description: Subject of the voorstel (usually derived from case title)

steller.description: Nextcloud user UID who created the voorstel
steller.title: Steller

portefeuillehouder.description: Nextcloud user UID of the responsible portfolio holder (wethouder)

status.description: Current status of the voorstel in the parafering lifecycle
status.title: Status

parafeerroute.description: Reference to the parafeerroute being used

routeSnapshot.description: Snapshot of the parafeerroute steps at submission time (JSON-encoded array)

currentStep.description: Current step number in the parafeerroute (1-based, 0 = not yet submitted)

returnedFromStep.description: Step number from which the voorstel was returned (for resume on resubmit)

document.description: Nextcloud file ID of the primary voorstel document

bijlagen.description: Nextcloud file IDs of attached documents (bijlagen)

behandeling.description: Treatment type in the college meeting

decision.description: Reference to the linked decision (set when besluit is registered)

sendBack.description: Send the proposal back for revisions.

revise.description: Take a returned proposal back into draft.

parafeerroute.title: Parafeerroute
parafeerroute.description: A configurable endorsement route defining the sequence of parafering steps for a voorstel

name.description: Name of this parafeerroute (e.g. Collegeadvies - Omgevingsvergunning)

caseType.description: Reference to the case type this route is associated with

voorstelType.description: Voorstel type this route applies to

actor.description: User UID, group name, or role name

mandatory.description: Whether this step can be skipped

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default route for the linked case type and voorstel type

description.description: Description of when this route should be used

parafeeractie.title: Parafeeractie
parafeeractie.description: An immutable record of a parafering action on a voorstel step

actor.description: Nextcloud user UID who performed the action

actorType.description: Whether the actor acted directly or as delegate

onBehalfOf.description: Nextcloud user UID of the principal (if acting as delegate)

workflowTemplate.title: Workflow Template
workflowTemplate.description: A workflow definition for a case type — defines process steps, status transitions, guards, and automatic actions. v1.1: each step entry MAY carry an additive `config` sub-object ({sla, requiredFields, autoActions, escalationRule}); absent config preserves v1 behaviour (see process-step-configuration spec).

description.description: Purpose and usage notes for this workflow

caseType.description: Reference to the case type this workflow belongs to

isActive.description: Whether this is the active version for new cases

isDraft.description: Draft templates cannot be used for new cases (legacy flag; lifecycleStatus is authoritative)

lifecycleStatus.description: Lifecycle state of this definition. Authoritative going forward; isDraft/isActive remain for backwards compatibility. draft = editable, cannot back new cases. published = immutable, can back new cases (one active per caseType). deprecated = immutable, cannot back new cases, existing cases keep using it.

steps.description: JSON-encoded array of WorkflowStep objects. Each step has: id (UUID), title, description, status (UUID ref to statusType), order (integer), assigneeRole (UUID ref to roleType, optional — legacy, normalised on read to routingRule.single-role), routingRule (optional object {strategy: single-role|or-set|hierarchical|round-robin|least-loaded, roleType: UUID, roleTypes: [UUID], fallback: UUID}), isRequired (boolean), checklist (array of {id, label, description}), automaticActions (array of ActionRef). v1.1 additive: optional `config` sub-object = {sla:{value:int 1-10000, unit:hours|businessDays|calendarDays}, requiredFields:string[] (case-field property paths), autoActions:ActionRef[] fired before transition-level actions on step completion, escalationRule:{trigger:preBreach|slaBreached, offset:int, offsetUnit:hours|businessDays, notifyRole:UUID, escalateToRole:UUID, openIncident:boolean} — requires sla present; preBreach offset must be <= sla.value}. Absent config preserves v1 behaviour.

transitions.description: JSON-encoded array of StatusTransition objects. Each transition has: id (UUID), fromStatus (UUID), toStatus (UUID), label (string), guards (array of Guard), automaticActions (array of ActionRef), allowedRoles (array of UUID — legacy, normalised on read to routingRule.or-set), routingRule (optional object same shape as workflowStep.routingRule). Guard types: checklist, requiredField, requiredDocument, roleGuard. Action types: sendEmail, createTask, createSubCase, webhook, setField, notify

nodePositions.description: JSON-encoded map of status UUID to {x, y} canvas positions for the visual editor

parentWorkflow.description: Reference to parent workflow template for inheritance (Enterprise tier)

paraferingAuditEntry.title: Parafering audit entry
paraferingAuditEntry.description: Append-only, regulator-grade audit entry for a parafeerroute transition. One entry per transition (started, paraferd, advised, terugsturen, route-changed, completed). Captures actor, role, timestamp, reason, content snapshot at action moment, redacted IP, and SHA-256 hash of the canonical payload for tamper detection. UPDATE and DELETE are blocked by the ParaferingAuditAppendOnlyValidator listener.

voorstel.description: Reference to the voorstel that this transition occurred on

step.description: Step identifier or order within the routeSnapshot at action moment (string to support both numeric orders and UUID refs)

action.title: Action
action.description: Transition type that produced this audit entry

actor.description: Nextcloud user UID who triggered the transition (always the session user, never request body)

actorRole.description: Role at the moment of action (steller, adviseur, parafeerder, accorderend, beheerder, secretariaat) derived from the routeSnapshot step or admin-override context

timestamp.description: Server-side ISO 8601 (UTC) timestamp at write moment, never accepted from client

reason.description: Reason text; mandatory for terugsturen and route-changed, optional for others

contentSnapshot.description: Immutable JSON copy of voorstel.{onderwerp, document, bijlagen, routeSnapshot, currentStep, status} at transition moment

ipAddress.description: Originating IP address redacted to /24 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6) per AVG minimisation

auditEntryHash.description: SHA-256 (64 lowercase hex) of canonical JSON of the entry excluding this field, for tamper detection

automaticAction.title: Automatic Action
automaticAction.description: Declarative automatic action attached to a status transition. The slug is referenced from transitions[].automaticActions[].ref and resolved at dispatch time by ActionRegistry. Six built-in handler types are supported; per-tenant scoped; unpublished actions are not resolvable.

slug.description: Tenant-unique slug used in transitions[].automaticActions[].ref (e.g. send-decision-email)

type.description: Action handler type — must match a registered ActionHandlerInterface implementation

tenantId.description: Owning tenant — cross-tenant resolution is rejected by the registry

description.description: Optional human description of what this action does

config.description: JSON-encoded handler-specific config (e.g. for sendEmail: {recipientRef, subjectTemplate, bodyTemplate}; for callWebhook: {urlSlug, payloadTemplate, timeoutSec})

version.description: Optimistic-lock counter; incremented on every save

isPublished.description: Only published actions are dispatched by SideEffectDispatcher

active.description: Soft-disable flag; inactive actions are filtered out of admin listings

bezwaar.title: Bezwaar
bezwaar.description: Bezwaar lifecycle entity — captures the AWB objection case state, statutory deadlines, hearing waiver, and dwangsom accrual. Status transitions flow through the status-transition-engine; deadlines are computed declaratively via x-openregister-calculations (ADR-022). NO bespoke deadline service.

case.description: The underlying procest case (zaaktype = Bezwaar) this lifecycle record belongs to

objection.description: The bezwaarschrift (objection letter) tied to this lifecycle record

status.description: Bezwaar lifecycle status — drives the status-transition-engine state machine

awbReference.description: AWB article reference for the most recent legal-posture transition (e.g. 'Awb 7:10 lid 3'); required by guards on verdaging/opschorting/niet-ontvankelijk/intrekking transitions

ontvangstdatum.description: Date the bezwaarschrift was received (start of the AWB 7:10 lid 1 termijn)

verdaagdOp.description: Date verdaging (extension) was recorded per AWB 7:10 lid 3

verdagingsperiode.description: Verdaging in days (0 = no verdaging; 42 = standard 6-week extension)

opschortingStart.description: Opschorting start date per AWB 7:10 lid 4

opschortingEnd.description: Opschorting end date — adds (end - start) days to decisionDeadline

opschorting.description: Opschorting in days (computed elapsed delta between opschortingStart/End)

hearingWaived.description: Whether the belanghebbende has waived the hoorrecht per AWB 7:3

ingebrekestelling.description: Date the bezwaarmaker submitted an ingebrekestelling per AWB 4:17 — starts the 14-day grace clock

dwangsom.description: Accrued dwangsom liability in euros — computed declaratively, capped at €1442 (AWB 4:17 lid 2)

decisionDeadline.description: Statutory deadline for the beslissing op bezwaar — computed as ontvangstdatum + 6 weeks + verdagingsperiode + opschorting (AWB 7:10)

objection.title: Objection
objection.description: Bezwaarschrift (objection letter) — captures the formal objection content linked to a bezwaar case and the contested decision

case.description: The bezwaar case this objection belongs to

grounds.description: The grounds for objection (gronden van bezwaar)

isTimely.description: Whether the objection was filed within the 6-week term (Awb art. 6:7)

proVoorziening.description: Whether a voorlopige voorziening (interim relief) was requested

attachments.description: JSON-encoded array of document references uploaded by bezwaarmaker

hearingSession.title: Hearing Session
hearingSession.description: Hoorzitting (hearing) — manages scheduling, invitations, inspection-of-file, attendance, minutes and audit hooks for bezwaar hearings per Awb art. 7:2-7:7

case.description: The bezwaar case this hearing belongs to

scheduledDate.description: Date and time of the hearing

location.description: Physical location or 'Online' for video hearings

videoCallUrl.description: Video conference link for online hearings

members.description: Committee member role UUIDs present at the hearing

invitees.description: Invitees array: each entry {role, name, channel (berichtenbox|email|post|in_person), accessibilityNeeds[], requestedLanguage?, invitedAt?}

inspectionAvailableFrom.description: First date the bezwaardossier is available for inspection (Awb art. 7:4)

inspectionDeadline.description: Inspection-of-file deadline = scheduledDate - 7 days (Awb art. 7:4 lid 2). Computed by HearingService on save.

attendance.description: Captured during/after hearing: {invitee, present (bool), arrivalTime?, correctionReason?}

minutesSummary.description: Summary of what was discussed (verslag, Awb art. 7:7)

minutesDocument.description: Reference to full hearing minutes document

audioRecording.description: Optional audio capture; only accepted when recordingConsent = granted (Awb art. 7:7 + AVG art. 6)

followUpQuestions.description: Post-hearing questions: {question, askedTo, deadline, answeredAt?, withdrawnAt?}

hearingWaived.description: Bezwaarmaker has waived the right to be heard (Awb art. 7:3)

waiverReason.description: Reason for waiving hearing right; required when hearingWaived = true

attendanceFrozenAt.description: Timestamp after which the attendance array becomes append-only (1-hour grace window after hearing concludes)

auditTrail.description: Append-only audit entries tagged with applicable Awb article (awb-art-7:2|7:3|7:4|7:6|7:7|7:13 or avg-art-6)

execute.description: Mark the hearing as carried out.

advisoryReport.title: Advisory Report
advisoryReport.description: Advisory committee report (advies bezwaarschriftencommissie) — records the committee's advice on a bezwaar case per Awb art. 7:13

case.description: The bezwaar case this report belongs to

hearingSession.description: The hearing session this report is based on

committeeMembers.description: JSON-encoded array of committee member role UUIDs

adviceType.description: Type of advice: upheld, rejected, partially upheld, inadmissible

grounds.description: Legal reasoning and grounds for the advice

deviationFromPrimaryDecision.description: Whether the committee advises differently from the original decision

reportDocument.description: Reference to full advisory report document

appealDecision.title: Appeal Decision
appealDecision.description: Beslissing op bezwaar (decision on objection) — formal decision recording with disposition, motivation, and rechtsmiddelenclausule per Awb art. 7:11-7:12

dispositionDetails.description: Detailed motivation for the decision (motiveringsplicht art. 7:12)

followsAdvice.description: Whether the decision follows the committee's advice

deviationReason.description: Reason for deviating from committee advice (required when followsAdvice is false)

replacementDecision.description: New besluit that replaces the contested one

effectiveDate.description: Date the decision takes legal effect

decisionMaker.description: The person/body that made the decision

decisionDocument.description: Reference to the formal decision letter document

bezwaarDecision.title: Bezwaar Decision
bezwaarDecision.description: Beslissing op bezwaar — canonical decision entity per Awb art. 7:11/7:12 with the 5-value disposition enum, structured rechtsmiddelenclausule, proceskostenvergoeding, and publication flow

bezwaar.description: The bezwaar case this decision belongs to

dispositionType.description: Awb art. 7:11 canonical outcome — drives mandatory fields, replacement besluit, and proceskosten eligibility

reasoning.description: Substantive motivation (motiveringsplicht Awb art. 7:12); for niet_ontvankelijk MUST cite Awb 6:5/6:6/6:7

legalBasis.description: Awb article(s) and/or sectoral wettelijke grondslag the decision rests on

advisoryOpinion.description: Linked BAC advisory request (Awb 7:13); when set, followsAdvice and deviationRationale apply

followsAdvice.description: Whether this decision follows the BAC advisory opinion

deviationRationale.description: Required when advisoryOpinion is set and the decision deviates from the committee advice (Awb art. 7:13 lid 7)

replacementDecision.description: New besluit replacing the primair besluit — required when dispositionType is gegrond_wijzigen, optional for gegrond_herroepen, MUST NOT be set otherwise

appealNotice.description: Structured rechtsmiddelenclausule — replaces free-form prose; every required sub-field MUST be filled before publication

beroepTerm.description: ISO 8601 duration of the beroep filing window; default P6W (Awb 6:7)

filingMethod.description: How beroep may be filed; drives whether filingUrl and/or filingAddress are required

filingUrl.description: Digital filing URL (required when filingMethod is digitaal or beide)

filingAddress.description: Postal filing address (required when filingMethod is schriftelijk or beide)

voorlopigeVoorziening.description: Mentions option to request voorlopige voorziening at the court

proceskostenvergoeding.description: Awb art. 7:15 cost award — awardable only when dispositionType is gegrond_herroepen or gegrond_wijzigen, the bezwaarmaker requested it, and the herroeping is attributable to onrechtmatigheid van het primair besluit; totalAmount is calculated as awardedPoints * pointValue

requested.description: Whether the bezwaarmaker requested proceskostenvergoeding before the beslissing

awarded.description: Explicit awarded/declined decision; MUST be set with reasoning when requested is true and disposition is gegrond_herroepen or gegrond_wijzigen

pointValue.description: EUR per point at the time of beslissing

reasoning.description: Motivation for awarding or refusing proceskostenvergoeding

paymentDate.description: Date the proceskosten were paid out

decisionDate.description: Date the decision was made; validated against bezwaar.afhandelDeadline (Awb 7:10)

effectiveDate.description: Date the decision takes legal effect; beroep-clock runs from here

decisionMaker.description: Bestuursorgaan or mandated official; derived from mandate config, never from request body

decisionDocument.description: Nextcloud file ID of the generated PDF beslissing op bezwaar

publishedAt.description: Set on transition to published; once set the bezwaarDecision is immutable

notifiedRecipients.description: Audit of UIDs/email addresses notified on publication; berichtenbox deliveries are prefixed 'berichtenbox:'

status.description: Draft until publish() validates required fields and sets publishedAt

beroep.title: Beroep
beroep.description: Beroep escalation envelope — the municipality's tracking record around a citizen's appeal of a beslissing op bezwaar at the administrative court (rechtbank, Awb hoofdstuk 8). Procest does NOT run the court process; this schema captures filing window, court reference, chamber, file-inspection requests (Awb 8:42), judgment outcome, and cascade back into the bezwaar workflow. Immutability after appellantFilingDate is enforced by BeroepService; OpenRegister provides the per-save audit trail.

case.description: The procest case that wraps the beroep (zaaktype = Beroep)

sourceBezwaar.description: The bezwaar lifecycle record that escalated to beroep — immutable after appellantFilingDate is set

contestedDecision.description: The beslissing op bezwaar being contested — immutable after appellantFilingDate is set

courtReference.description: Rechtbank zaaknummer (e.g. 'UTR 26/1234'), populated once the court assigns one

responsibleChamber.description: Court chamber composition; defaults to enkelvoudig, may be upgraded by the rechtbank

competentCourt.description: Name of the competent rechtbank (e.g. 'Rechtbank Midden-Nederland')

appellantFilingDate.description: Date the beroepschrift was filed at the court (Awb 6:7)

appellantNotifiedDate.description: Date the municipality received the rechtbank notification of the beroep

filingDeadline.description: Computed: contestedDecision.effectiveDate + P6W (Awb 6:7, 6:8). The system NEVER decides timeliness itself; the rechtbank does.

voorzieningRequested.description: Whether a voorlopige voorziening (provisional ruling) was also filed alongside the beroep

latefilingNotice.description: Computed: true when appellantFilingDate > filingDeadline. Informational only — only the rechtbank weighs verschoonbare termijnoverschrijding.

requestedAt.description: Date the rechtbank issued the file inspection request (Awb 8:42)

submittedAt.description: Date the bestuursorgaan submitted the dossier

dossierBundle.description: Reference to the compiled bundle (NC file ID or document-zaakdossier artifact)

fileInspectionRequests.description: Sub-records tracking each Awb 8:42 file inspection request. Procest records the linkage; Juridische Zaken curates the bundle.

judgmentOutcome.description: Categorical outcome of the rechtbank's uitspraak. Procest persists the category and the uploaded ruling; never paraphrases the ruling.

judgmentDocument.description: Nextcloud file ID of the rechtbank's uitspraak document

cascadeAction.description: Cascade action triggered by the judgment outcome. reopen_bezwaar forks a new bezwaar via status-transition-engine; new_primary_decision opens a fresh decision case; none clears the dwingende marker on the source bezwaar.

cascadeBezwaarCase.description: The reopened bezwaar case created by cascadeAction = reopen_bezwaar

mapLayer.title: Map Layer
mapLayer.description: GIS map layer configuration for case maps — defines tile, WMS, WFS, or GeoJSON layers that can be displayed on case map views

title.description: Display name for the layer in the layer switcher

layerType.description: The type of map layer (tile, wms, wfs, or geojson)

url.description: Service URL (tile template, WMS base URL, WFS endpoint, or GeoJSON URL)

isDefault.description: Whether to show this layer on initial load

isBaseLayer.description: If true, only one base layer visible at a time

order.description: Display order in the layer switcher

style.description: JSON-encoded style object for GeoJSON/WFS features (color, weight, fillColor, fillOpacity)

proxyEnabled.description: Whether to route requests through the backend GIS proxy (for CORS-restricted services)

wmsLayer.title: WMS/WFS Layer
wmsLayer.description: Tenant-configurable OGC WMS/WFS overlay layer for case maps. Subscribed per case type via caseType.layerIds. All outbound traffic routed through the GIS proxy (wms-wfs-layers REQ-WMS-3).

title.description: Display name shown in legend and layer switcher

type.description: OGC service type (WMS for raster overlays, WFS for vector features)

url.description: Service base URL — MUST match an entry in the GIS proxy allowlist (REQ-WMS-3)

layerName.description: WMS LAYERS parameter or WFS typeName

srs.description: Spatial reference system. EPSG:28992 = Rijksdriehoek (RD); EPSG:3857 = Web Mercator

attribution.description: Attribution text rendered as escaped text in legend (no HTML)

queryable.description: If true, the map binds GetFeatureInfo (WMS) or feature popup (WFS) on click (REQ-WMS-7)

version.description: OGC version. Default: 1.3.0 for WMS, 2.0.0 for WFS

extentCutoffKm.description: Maximum visible extent in km before WFS requests are suppressed and 'Zoom in voor details' is shown (REQ-WMS-8)

isDefault.description: Show on initial load even without case-type subscription

active.description: If false, the layer is hidden from selection but kept for audit

location.title: Case Location
location.description: A geographic location attached to a case (BAG nummeraanduiding, parcel, or free address) — 0..N locations per case via back-reference on `case`.

case.description: Reference to the case this location is attached to

label.description: Short human label shown in the case header (e.g. 'Inspectielocatie 1')

nummeraanduidingId.description: BAG nummeraanduiding identifier (16-digit) — MUST be present when source = bag

accuracyRadius.description: Radius in metres around lat/lng (used when source is gps or free)

source.description: Provenance of this location (bag = validated against BAG; pdok-reverse = reverse-geocoded; gps = field capture; free = manual; geocoded = forward-geocoded; import = CSV importer)

adviesAanvraag.title: Advice Request
adviesAanvraag.description: A request for internal or external advice on a case, with deadline tracking

case.description: Reference to the case this advice is requested for

type.description: Whether advice is from internal staff or external party

status.description: Current status of the advice request

adviesDocument.description: Nextcloud file ID of the advice document

requestedAt.description: Timestamp when the advice was requested

receivedAt.description: Timestamp when the advice was received

expire.description: Mark the advice request as expired.

legesverordening.title: Legesverordening
legesverordening.description: A municipal fee regulation (legesverordening) — the legal basis for charging fees on permit cases, containing a versioned set of articles with calculation rules

description.description: Detailed description of the regulation and its scope

effectiveDate.description: Date on which this verordening enters into force

endDate.description: Date on which this verordening is no longer effective (optional)

year.description: Calendar year this verordening applies to

globalMaximum.description: Optional global cap on the total leges calculated under this verordening

reference.description: Official reference (raadsbesluit, publication URL, or DROP/CVDR identifier)

isActive.description: Whether this verordening is currently the active one for new calculations

legesartikel.title: Legesartikel
legesartikel.description: A single article (tariff line) inside a legesverordening, with its calculation rule (vast, percentage, staffel, maximum, combinatie)

omschrijving.description: Description of what this article covers

grondslagField.description: Name of the case-data field used as the calculation base (grondslag)

bedrag.description: Fixed amount (used when type is vast)

percentage.description: Percentage rate (used when type is percentage)

maximum.description: Cap value (used when type is maximum)

subType.description: Sub-calculation strategy when type is maximum

to.description: Upper bound of this bracket (exclusive); omit for unbounded

brackets.description: Tiered brackets (used when type is staffel)

subArtikelen.description: Nested article definitions (used when type is combinatie)

category.description: Optional grouping category for display (e.g. Omgevingsvergunning)

legesberekening.title: Legesberekening
legesberekening.description: A single fee calculation produced for a case under a specific legesverordening, with breakdown per artikel, audit trail and version history

case.description: Reference to the case this calculation belongs to

verordening.description: Name or reference of the applied verordening at calculation time

total.description: Total calculated leges amount (after global maximum is applied)

type.description: Calculation type used for this artikel

calculatedBy.description: User UID of the person who triggered the calculation

version.description: Version number; increments on each recalculation

previousVersion.description: Previous version number (when this is a recalculation)

previousTotal.description: Total of the previous calculation (when this is a recalculation)

difference.description: Difference vs the previous total (positive = higher, negative = lower)

correctionReason.description: Reason supplied when this calculation corrects a previous one

status.description: Status of the calculation within the billing lifecycle

exportedAt.description: Timestamp of last export to the financial system

handhavingsactie.title: Enforcement Action
handhavingsactie.description: An enforcement action (handhavingsactie) on a case, classified per the Landelijke Handhavingsstrategie (LHS)

ernst.description: Severity of the violation (LHS ernst axis)

gedrag.description: Behavior of the violator (LHS gedrag axis)

interventie.description: Suggested intervention from LHS matrix (may be overridden)

begunstigingstermijn.description: Grace period in days before enforcement takes effect

effectueringsDatum.description: Date when enforcement action takes effect

status.description: Current status of the enforcement action

overrideReason.description: Documented reasoning if the LHS suggestion was overridden

forfeit.description: Mark the enforcement action as forfeited.

execute.description: Mark the enforcement action as executed.

lhsMatrix.title: LHS Matrix
lhsMatrix.description: Versioned 3-dimensional Landelijke Handhavingsstrategie matrix (ernst x gedrag x actorType). Immutable per version; edits create new versions.

name.description: Name of this matrix version (e.g. 'Landelijke Handhavingsstrategie 2024')

version.description: Monotonic version number; new edits create a new version (immutable history)

active.description: Whether this is the currently active matrix. Exactly one matrix is active=true per tenant.

ernstAxis.description: Ordered severity axis values, e.g. [gering, aanzienlijk, ernstig]

gedragAxis.description: Ordered behaviour axis values, e.g. [goedwillend, onverschillig, calculerend, crimineel]

actorTypeAxis.description: Ordered actor-type axis values, e.g. [burger, bedrijf, overheid, recidivist]

cells.description: Dense matrix; one entry per (ernst, gedrag, actorType) triple

auditTrail.description: Edit log capturing who, when, and which cells changed across versions

lhsRecommendation.title: LHS Recommendation
lhsRecommendation.description: Per-enforcement record of the LHS matrix lookup, the recommended intervention, and any inspector override with justification.

inspection.description: Optional reference to the originating inspection rapport

ernst.description: Severity of the violation (LHS ernst axis)

gedrag.description: Behaviour of the violator (LHS gedrag axis)

actorType.description: Actor type of the violator (LHS actorType axis)

matrixVersion.description: Frozen lhsMatrix version this recommendation was looked up against

recommendedInterventie.description: Intervention prescribed by the matrix cell

finalIntervention.description: Intervention actually applied (may differ from recommended when override=true)

override.description: Whether the inspector overrode the matrix recommendation

overrideJustification.description: Mandatory justification when override=true (minimum 20 non-whitespace characters)

overrideBy.description: NC UID of the user who submitted the override

overrideAuthority.description: Role authority under which the override was applied. override-up requires manager.

recommendedBy.description: NC UID of the authenticated user who invoked the recommendation. Server-derived; never trusted from request body.

inspectieChecklist.title: Inspection Checklist
inspectieChecklist.description: Configurable inspection checklist template linked to a case type, with versioning support

name.description: Name of this checklist (e.g. 'Bouwtoezicht fase 1 - Fundering')

caseType.description: Reference to the case type this checklist belongs to

version.description: Version number of this checklist (incremented on edit)

status.description: Lifecycle status of this checklist version

required.description: Whether this item must be completed

fotoRequired.description: Whether a photo is required (especially on failure)

inspectieRapport.title: Inspection Report
inspectieRapport.description: A completed inspection report generated from a checklist, stored on the case

case.description: Reference to the case (toezichtzaak) this report belongs to

inspectionDate.description: Date and time of the inspection

location.description: GPS coordinates or address of the inspection location

itemId.description: Reference to the original checklist item

photos.description: Nextcloud file IDs of photos for this item
All Nextcloud file IDs of photos taken during inspection

inspectionChecklistTemplate.title: Inspection Checklist Template
inspectionChecklistTemplate.description: Long-lived configuration template for an inspection checklist (REQ-IC-1). Owns sections, items, response-type rules, and follow-up action defaults. Versioned per REQ-IC-8 — published edits create a new version and retire the prior one.

caseType.description: Optional case-type binding; null means any case type

version.description: Monotonic template version, frozen once a run consumes it

status.description: Lifecycle status of this template version

active.description: Convenience flag mirroring status=active for list filtering

sections.description: Ordered sections each carrying their own items[]

items.description: Ordered checklist items in this section

responseType.description: Input type — drives validation in REQ-IC-3

required.description: Whether the item must be answered

numericRange.description: Only used when responseType is getal or meting

choices.description: Allowed values when responseType is meerkeuze

template.description: Optional template ref for the follow-up artefact

deadlineDays.description: Days from submit to follow-up deadline

seedKey.description: Idempotent seed identifier when shipped via repair-step seeds

inspectionChecklistRun.title: Inspection Checklist Run
inspectionChecklistRun.description: Per-inspection runtime instance of an inspectionChecklistTemplate (REQ-IC-2). Once submitted (status=ingediend) the run is append-only: edits are rejected by REQ-IC-8 enforcement.

template.description: inspectionChecklistTemplate reference chosen at run start

templateVersion.description: Template version captured at run start (REQ-IC-8)

templateSnapshot.description: Frozen JSON copy of the template sections+items at run start — hidden from default API output

inspector.description: NC user UID — server-derived from IUserSession, never accepted from body

submittedAt.description: Alias of completedAt; populated on submit

audio.description: Nextcloud file IDs for audio recordings

photos.description: All Nextcloud file IDs of photos attached to this run

overallResult.description: Aggregate result — derived on submit by ChecklistService::aggregateResult (REQ-IC-6); user-supplied values are ignored

syncState.description: Offline-sync state for the whole run (REQ-IC-5)

followUpType.description: Highest-priority follow-up type dispatched on submit (REQ-IC-7)

tenant.title: Tenant
tenant.description: A tenant (municipality) in a multi-tenant Procest deployment

registerId.description: OpenRegister register ID for this tenant

aiAuditEntry.title: AI Audit Entry
aiAuditEntry.description: Immutable audit log entry for AI-assisted processing interactions

type.description: AI feature type that produced the entry
type.title: Type

caseId.description: Reference to the case (zaak) the AI was invoked on

documentId.description: Reference to the document (informatieobject) if applicable

model.description: Identifier of the AI model used (e.g. qwen3.5:9b)

prompt.description: Prompt sent to the AI model (PII-stripped if enabled)

userAction.description: Action taken by the human user on the suggestion

actualValue.description: Final value applied by the user (if modified)

userId.description: Nextcloud user UID who triggered the AI call

timestamp.description: When the AI call was made

caseShare.title: Case share
caseShare.description: Token- or partner-based share over a case for external collaboration

partnerId.description: UUID of the partner organisation (partner shares only)

permissionLevel.description: Permission level slug (e.g. bekijken, bekijken_reageren, bekijken_bijdragen)

password.description: Bcrypt hashed password (never returned in plaintext)

fieldExclusions.description: JSON-encoded list of field names to exclude from the shared view

createdBy.description: User ID of the share creator

lastAccessedAt.description: Last external access datetime in ISO 8601

partnerOrganization.title: Partner organization
partnerOrganization.description: External organisation (ketenpartner) participating in shared cases

defaultPermissionLevel.description: Default permission level for new shares

casetransfer.title: Case transfer
casetransfer.description: Hand-off of a case from one organisation to another (initiate / accept / reject)

caseId.description: UUID of the case being transferred

rejectionReason.description: Reason given when transfer is rejected

bezwaaradviescommissie.title: Bezwaaradviescommissie
bezwaaradviescommissie.description: Independent advisory committee (BAC, VKK or VTH) that reviews objections under Awb Art. 7:13 and issues a written advice to the council. Long-lived configuration entity owned by the council; member independence is enforced per case at advice-request assignment.

type.description: Committee type: BAC (Bezwaar Advies), VKK (Vaste Kamer/Klachten), VTH (Vergunning Toezicht Handhaving)

domain.description: Optional jurisdiction filter for auto-assignment by case type / domain

jurisdiction.description: Free-text jurisdiction descriptor (e.g. municipal area, region, or 'all')

chair.description: Nextcloud UID of the committee chair (voorzitter, Awb Art. 7:13(1))

uid.description: Nextcloud UID or external party reference

external.description: Whether this member is external to the council (not a civil servant)

members.description: Committee members; chair + at least two members required (Awb Art. 7:13(1))

secretary.description: Nextcloud UID of the secretary (civil servant per Awb Art. 7:13(2))

quorum.description: Minimum members needed to issue advice

active.description: Whether the committee is active and can be assigned new cases

bacAdviceRequest.title: BAC Advice Request
bacAdviceRequest.description: Per-bezwaar referral of an objection case to a bezwaaradviescommissie. Tracks the advice deliverable through the assigned -> in-deliberation -> advice-issued lifecycle (Awb Art. 7:13). One-way transitions; withdrawn bezwaaren leave the request in its last state for audit.

bezwaar.description: The bezwaar (lifecycle record) being reviewed; the wrapped procest case is resolved via bezwaar.case

panel.description: Subset of commissie.members.uid actually sitting on this case (used for independence check per Awb Art. 7:13(3))

status.description: Lifecycle state. niet-ontvankelijk represents the terminal advice that the bezwaar is inadmissible (Awb Art. 7:13(7))

assignedAt.description: Server timestamp when the council referred the bezwaar to the committee

deadline.description: Target advice date — defaults to assignedAt + 12 weeks (Awb Art. 7:24(1))

advice.description: Advice text (findings + legal_assessment + recommendation). Free-text fallback when no structured document is uploaded

adviceDocuments.description: References (Nextcloud file IDs or OpenRegister doc refs) of the signed advice and supporting documents

adviceIssuedAt.description: Timestamp the chair signed and issued the advice

signatureEvidence.description: Reference (NC file ID or signing-app evidence ref) to the chair's signature evidence

hearingReportRef.description: Link to the hoorzittingverslag owned by the bezwaar-lifecycle / hearing-session

dissentingOpinions.description: Optional dissenting opinions when panel disagreement exists

auditTrail.description: Append-only audit trail for BAC-specific events (Archiefwet 1995). Complements the OpenRegister automatic per-save log.

inspectionChecklist.title: Inspection Checklist
inspectionChecklist.description: Reusable checklist template defining the inspection items for a given case type. A versioned master form that inspection runs are based on.

name.description: Human-readable name of the checklist template.

version.description: Template version number; increment when items are added or removed.

caseTypeRef.description: The case type this checklist applies to.

items.description: Ordered list of checklist items (questions) that make up this template.

active.description: Whether this checklist template is currently active and available for new inspection runs.

validFrom.description: Date from which this version of the checklist is valid.

checklistItem.title: Checklist Item
checklistItem.description: A single question or observation point within an inspection checklist. Supports boolean, enum, text, and photo answer types.

question.description: The question or observation text shown to the inspector.

type.description: Answer type: boolean (yes/no), enum (predefined options), text (free-text), or photo (image attachment required).

required.description: Whether an answer to this item is mandatory before the inspection run can be submitted.

weight.description: Relative weight of this item when computing an aggregate inspection score.

parent.description: Slug or ID of a parent checklist item, enabling nested / conditional item hierarchies.

inspectionResult.title: Inspection Result
inspectionResult.description: The completed outcome of a single inspection run: which checklist was used, who completed it, and the recorded answers.

case.description: The case this inspection result belongs to.

checklist.description: The checklist template that was used for this inspection run.

completedBy.description: UID of the inspector who completed the checklist.

completedAt.description: Timestamp when the inspection run was finalised.

itemRef.description: Reference to the checklist item (slug or ID) being answered.

value.description: The recorded answer value (coerced to string; interpret according to item type).

photoRef.description: Nextcloud file ID or OpenRegister document reference for a photo answer.

answers.description: Recorded answers for each checklist item in this inspection run.

adviceRequest.title: Advice Request
adviceRequest.description: A request for advice from an internal or external adviser on a specific case. Tracks the full lifecycle from open to received or cancelled.

case.description: The case for which advice is requested.

requestedBy.description: UID of the user who submitted the advice request.

adviseur.description: Name or UID of the adviser (person, team, or external party) being consulted.

deadline.description: Date by which the advice must be received.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the advice request.

vraag.description: The question(s) put to the adviser.

adviesText.description: The advice text returned by the adviser once received.

addedToFile.description: Whether the received advice has been added to the case dossier.

lhsMatrixCell.title: LHS Matrix Cell
lhsMatrixCell.description: A single cell in the Landelijk Handhavingsbeleid Stedenbouw (LHS) intervention matrix, mapping a behaviour row and consequence column to a recommended intervention step.

gedragRow.description: The behaviour (gedrag) row identifier in the LHS matrix.

gevolgColumn.description: The consequence (gevolg) column identifier in the LHS matrix.

interventieStep.description: The recommended intervention step for this gedrag/gevolg combination.

description.description: Optional clarifying description or guidance note for this matrix cell.

procest.title: Procest
procest.description: Case management (zaakgericht werken) register for Procest — manages case types, status types, cases, tasks, roles, results, and decisions.

x-pages.title: Parafering audit trail
x-pages.description: Append-only audit trail of every parafeerroute transition on a voorstel. Visible to auditors, secretariaat, and beheerders.
